Question Choices: A checking account holds $36.20 when a debit of $51.45 is posted. Fill in the blanks: the new balance is 36.20 + ___ = ___.
Hints: A debit is a negative change.
Solution: 36.20 + (-51.45) = -15.25, so the account is overdrawn by $15.25.
